Create a FastAPI application in a file located at 'E:\Hackathon\buddy-agent\app.py'. The file should include necessary imports and initialization of a FastAPI app instance. Implement a POST endpoint at path '/health' that returns a JSON response indicating the service is healthy, e.g., {"status": "healthy"}. No database interactions or additional business logic are required. Ensure the endpoint is defined using the @app.post decorator and the function is async.
